item.description: Submit and manage support tickets for the active center.

Lists all support tickets submitted by the active center.

item.name: Patient
item.description: Patient Portal Endpoints for viewing treatment plans, diet programs, exercise lists, and logging progress.

request.description: Retrieves patient header info, week number, assigned therapist, medical history, diagnosis info, and treatment plan (medications, manual therapy, electrotherapy, goals).

response.name: 200 OK - Patient Treatment Plan

request.description: Retrieves patient diet plan meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, supplements, foods to avoid).

response.name: 200 OK - Patient Diet Plan

request.description: Retrieves patient assigned exercises program with completion percentage and weekly stats.

response.name: 200 OK - Exercise Progress Overview

request.description: Logs sets and repeats execution for today ("Count Repeat"). Updates exercise status to in_progress or completed.

response.name: 200 OK - Exercise Progress Logged

request.description: Marks assigned exercise as 100% completed for today.

response.name: 200 OK - Exercise Completed
